instruction: I want to enable syntax highlighting in Vim by default. Search for how to enable syntax highlighting in Vim configuration and add the appropriate setting to my .vimrc file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
